list.title: Bots
list.description: The bots your customers talk to in chat and email. Give each one a name, a face and a voice, then pick which widget or address it answers on.
list.sectionHint: The default answers wherever no other bot is picked. Drag to reorder.
list.footnote: In the app, the AI that drafts, triages and assists your team is always Ollie. Bots are what customers see.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: {{name}} and its look, personality and picture will be removed. Past messages keep its name.
delete.inUse: Can't delete {{name}} yet. {{where}}. Pick another bot there first.
delete.isDefault: Make another bot the default to delete this one

usage.none: Not used yet. Pick it on a widget or an address.
usage.defaultNone: Answers everywhere no other bot is picked

summary.title: Bots
summary.hint: Who answers your customers: their name, look and personality. Rules on this page apply to every bot.

picker.label: Bot
picker.widgetHint: Who answers visitors on this widget: its name, face, greeting and voice.
picker.widgetHintOff: Who answers once the AI agent is on for this widget.
picker.mailboxHint: Who answers and signs emails to this address when the AI agent replies.

detail.missingBody: It may have been deleted. Your other bots are still on the list.
detail.name: Name
detail.needsPicture: Upload a picture or pick another look

test.widgetHint: Your widget's settings with this bot. Nothing here is live until you save.
test.chatHint: Answers use your knowledge and tools, as this bot. Test chats are not saved as tickets.
test.try1: How do I reset my password?
test.try3: Can I talk to a person?

look.kindHint_built: Build a face from parts. Shuffle for ideas.
look.kindHint_emoji: Any emoji on a shape and colour you pick.
look.pictureHint: A square PNG, JPEG or WebP works best.
look.accentHint: Used for accessories and the ring.

tone.friendly_hint: Warm and easy, like a helpful colleague.
tone.friendly_sample: Hi! Happy to help with that. Here's what to do.
tone.professional_hint: Clear and composed, no small talk.
tone.professional_sample: Thank you for reaching out. Here are the steps to resolve this.
tone.playful_hint: Light and cheerful, still gets to the point.
tone.playful_sample: Ooh, good one! Let's sort this out together.
tone.concise_hint: As few words as the answer needs.
tone.concise_sample: Go to Settings, then Billing, then Cancel.
tone.warm_hint: Patient and kind, good for tricky moments.
tone.warm_sample: I'm sorry that happened. Let's get it fixed for you.
tone.custom_hint: Describe the voice in your own words.

personality.toneHint: How the bot sounds. It never changes what the bot is allowed to do.
personality.customTonePlaceholder: Calm, a little nerdy, explains the why
personality.lengthHint_detailed: Steps and context when they help.
personality.emojiHint_some: Now and then, where it fits.
personality.languageHint: Auto answers in the customer's language.
personality.greetingHint: The first message visitors see in the widget.
personality.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! I'm here to help. What can I do for you?
personality.handoffHint: What it says when it passes the chat to your team.
personality.handoffPlaceholder: I'm bringing in someone from the team. They'll reply here.
personality.signOffHint: How it signs emails. Leave empty to sign with its name.
personality.instructionsHint: What the bot should know about your product and how to help. Rules and guardrails always come first.
personality.instructionsPlaceholder: We sell project management software. Point billing questions to the billing page. Never promise delivery dates.
personality.knowledgeLink: Add articles and sources in Knowledge
personality.topicsHint: On top of the topics every bot declines.
personality.topicsPlaceholder: Add a topic and press Enter
